name: MINE
aliases: MINE (Multiplane Image with Neural Radiance Fields)
MINE: Towards Continuous Depth MPI with NeRF for Novel View Synthesis
Multiplane Image with Neural Radiance Fields
definition: MINE is a method for novel view synthesis that models the frustum of the source camera using continuous depth Multiplane Images (MPI), conditioned on input images via a fully-convolutional decoder, differing from pixelNeRF and GRF which model the entire 3D space per ray.
summary: MINE is a novel view synthesis method using continuous depth Multiplane Images to efficiently render multiple views via homography warping after a single encoder pass.
